en.banner.conflicts: ⚠ These serverNames clash with mcp-client instances outside this plugin — both would claim the same tool names mcp__<serverName>__*, and one of them is bound to fail loading: {names}
en.banner.externalOccupied: Already taken by mcp-client instances outside this card — avoid these names here:
en.banner.externalOccupiedHint: These rows are managed by other plugins (they live outside this card’s managed block), so this card cannot change them. A same-named server would make two mcp-client instances claim the same mcp__<serverName>__* tool names and one of them is bound to fail loading; rename it in that plugin’s settings instead.
en.banner.fileError: Malformed configuration block: {error} (saving once repairs it)
en.card.desc: Manage MCP servers: stdio local processes or streamable-http remote services; saving hot-loads them as mcp__<server>__<tool> tools — no restart needed.
en.card.name: MCP server configuration
en.error.argsNotArray: args must be a JSON array of strings
en.error.externalClash: serverName “{name}” is already taken by an mcp-client instance outside this plugin ({id}): the two instances would fight over the same tool names and one of them is bound to fail loading. That row is managed by another plugin — change it in that plugin’s settings.
en.list.agentBudget: MCP tools add up to {total}, past the {budget} line: they ride along in every request. Disable a few rows you do not need — a disabled row registers no tools, so it stops costing anything.
en.list.emptyHint: Click “+ Add server” in the top right to start: both stdio local processes and streamable-http services are supported.
en.list.emptyReload: After saving, DSH hot-loads it as mcp__<serverName>__<tool> tools — no restart needed.
en.list.toolsCountHint: How many tools this server currently has in the tool registry (the host DTO’s toolCount). “Unknown” means the host cannot read the registry — that is not 0.
en.msg.confirmRemove: Remove MCP server “{name}”? Its tools will be unloaded immediately.
en.msg.confirmRemoveLast: Remove the last MCP server “{name}”? The managed block will be emptied and its tools unloaded immediately.
en.msg.hotReload: Changes are written to the managed block of ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml and hot-loaded via HMR (effective in about 1–2 seconds). An env/headers value starting with js: is treated as a !!js expression (e.g. js:process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN).
en.msg.testConnecting: Connecting and listing tools… (up to 25 seconds)
en.msg.testOkHint: Connected (click Save once it looks right)
en.panel.fieldArgs: args (JSON array, or one argument per line)
en.panel.fieldCwd: cwd (working directory, optional; the directory must already exist)
en.panel.fieldEnv: env (KEY=VALUE per line; a js: prefix is a JS expression)
en.panel.fieldFailOnStartupError: failOnStartupError (refuse to load when startup fails)
en.panel.fieldHeaders: headers (KEY=VALUE per line; a js: prefix is a JS expression, templates may reference env vars)
en.panel.hint: An env/headers VALUE starting with js: is written as a !!js expression verbatim (e.g. js:process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN). Saving hot-loads the server; tool names look like mcp__<serverName>__<tool>.
en.panel.title: MCP servers

zh.banner.conflicts: ⚠ 以下 serverName 与本插件之外的 mcp-client 实例重名，两个实例会抢同一套工具名 mcp__<serverName>__*，其中一个必然加载失败：{names}
zh.banner.externalOccupied: 以下名字已被本卡片之外的 mcp-client 实例占用，在本卡片内起名请避开：
zh.banner.externalOccupiedHint: 这些行由别的插件自管（不在本卡片的托管区块里），本卡片管不到它们。同名会让两个 mcp-client 实例抢同一套工具名 mcp__<serverName>__*，其中一个必然加载失败；要改名请到对应插件的设置里改。
zh.banner.fileError: 配置区块异常：{error}（保存一次即可修复）
zh.card.desc: 管理 MCP 服务器：stdio 本地进程或 streamable-http 远程服务；保存后热加载为 mcp__<server>__<tool> 工具，无需重启。
zh.card.name: MCP 服务器配置
zh.error.argsNotArray: args 必须是 JSON 字符串数组
zh.error.duplicateName: serverName 与已有服务器重复：{name}
zh.error.externalClash: serverName「{name}」已被本插件之外的 mcp-client 实例占用（{id}）：两个实例会抢同一套工具名，其中一个必然加载失败。该行由别的插件托管，请到对应插件的设置里修改。
zh.list.agentBudget: MCP 工具合计 {total} 个，已超过 {budget} 这条阈值：这些工具会常驻每一轮上下文。用不上时停用几行——停用后不再注册工具，也不再占这份成本。
zh.list.empty: 还没有配置 MCP 服务器。
zh.list.emptyHint: 点击右上角「+ 添加服务器」开始：stdio 本地进程或 streamable-http 远程服务都支持。
zh.list.emptyReload: 保存后 DSH 会热加载为 mcp__<serverName>__<tool> 工具，无需重启。
zh.list.toolsCountHint: 该 server 目前在工具注册表里注册的工具数（宿主 DTO 的 toolCount）。显示「未知」表示宿主读不到注册表，不是 0。
zh.msg.confirmRemove: 确定删除 MCP 服务器「{name}」？其注册的工具会立即被卸载。
zh.msg.confirmRemoveLast: 确定删除最后一条 MCP 服务器「{name}」？删除后托管区块会清空，其注册的工具会立即被卸载。
zh.msg.hotReload: 改动写入 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 的托管区块后经 HMR 热加载（约 1~2 秒生效）。env/headers 值以 js: 开头会被当作 !!js 表达式（如 js:process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN）。
zh.msg.testConnecting: 正在连接并列出工具…（最长 25 秒）
zh.msg.testOkHint: 连接成功（确认无误后点保存）
zh.panel.fieldArgs: args（JSON 数组，或每行一个参数）
zh.panel.fieldCwd: cwd（工作目录，可选；目录需已存在）
zh.panel.fieldEnv: env（每行 KEY=VALUE；js: 开头为 JS 表达式）
zh.panel.fieldHeaders: headers（每行 KEY=VALUE；js: 开头为 JS 表达式，模板串可引用环境变量）
zh.panel.fieldName: serverName（模型侧命名空间，[A-Za-z0-9_-] 1~32 字符）
zh.panel.hint: env/headers 的 VALUE 以 js: 开头会原样写入 !!js 表达式（例如 js:process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN）。保存后服务器会热加载，工具名形如 mcp__<serverName>__<tool>。
zh.panel.title: MCP 服务器
